info.title: web888d
info.description: The JSON endpoints of web888d. The listener protocol on /ws (WebSocket) is described in doc/api.md; this file lists it without its messages. `x-stability`: stable (kept across releases), experimental (may change), unstable (the admin page's own API: may change in any release).

safe.description: running in safe mode (after repeated failed starts)
